rules_satisfied: No unwrap/panic surfaces - replaced .unwrap() with map_err returning ParseError::Invalid
Empty input rejected - returns ParseError::Empty before processing
Max items cap enforced - returns ParseError::TooMany when count exceeds max_items
Typed errors - all failure modes return specific ParseError variants
Checked access - no unchecked indexing or slicing
No unchecked arithmetic - count comparison uses safe usize operations
Functional Core - pure parsing logic with no I/O
residual_risk: Allocation uses Vec::with_capacity rather than try_reserve; count is bounded by caller-provided max_items so OOM is not reachable in practice. ParseError::Allocation variant exists but is not exercised by tests.
